candidate_changes: CPU clocks for sampled spans and direct children only; independent inclusive and exclusive CPU validity
host: Intel Core i5-1345U; logical CPU 2; powersave governor; Linux x86_64; Rust 1.89.0; native GStreamer 1.24.2
method: One warmup and seven measured rounds, alternating order; isolated registries and verified plugin paths; one scrape per second; no concurrent builds or test runs. Clock syscall counting ran separately from timing benchmarks.
units: Child-process CPU microseconds per source buffer, including GStreamer and process startup/teardown; not tracer-only cost.
clock_count_method: strace -f -e trace=clock_gettime; 1000 buffers per run; rate 16 uses process-specific sampling seeds, so exact sampled event counts differ between runs.
